summary: Iteration 105 - Guided Narration Category Defaults & Manual Override Testing. CRITICAL BUG FIXED: `getGuidedNarrationMode is not defined` error in GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx was blocking all guided meditations. Added missing import. Backend tests: 23/23 passed (100%). Frontend: GuidedPracticeOverlay now works correctly with mode switching.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Missing import `getGuidedNarrationMode` in GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx caused ReferenceError blocking all guided meditations
VERIFIED: Invalid mode values return 422 validation error
VERIFIED: Default mode is strict when not specified
VERIFIED: Word count floors (>=80%) met for all durations (7, 10, 15, 20, 25 min) in both modes
VERIFIED: Repetition quality maintained (stem repeat ratio <=0.12 for strict, <=0.15 for balanced)
VERIFIED: GuidedPracticeOverlay mode buttons work (Strict anti-repeat / Balanced flow)
VERIFIED: Mode switching shows visual feedback and toast notification
VERIFIED: Category keyword detection logic in guidedNarrationSettings.js is correct
test_credentials: No auth required for expand-script endpoint or meditations page
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 105 fixed a critical bug where `getGuidedNarrationMode` was not imported in GuidedPracticeOverlay.jsx, causing all guided meditations to crash with ReferenceError. The fix was adding the missing import. Category defaults logic (sunrise_sunset=balanced, deep_healing=strict, general=strict) is implemented in guidedNarrationSettings.js and works correctly. Manual override via Settings or overlay quick selector persists to localStorage and applies globally.

frontend_tests: Click meditation card opens GuidedPracticeOverlay - PASSED (after fix)
Mode switching works with visual feedback - PASSED

bug_fixed.root_cause: Function `getGuidedNarrationMode` was used but not imported from guidedNarrationSettings.js
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added `getGuidedNarrationMode` to the import statement on line 17-20
bug_fixed.verification: GuidedPracticeOverlay now opens correctly without errors, mode buttons work, narration plays

category_defaults.details: guidedNarrationSettings.js defines CATEGORY_DEFAULTS: sunrise_sunset=balanced, deep_healing=strict, general=strict. inferGuidedNarrationCategory() detects keywords and returns appropriate category.

manual_override.details: setGuidedNarrationMode() sets both mode and manual_override flag in localStorage. isGuidedNarrationManualOverrideEnabled() checks if manual override is active. getEffectiveGuidedNarrationMode() returns manual mode if override enabled, otherwise category default.

expand_script_api.details: POST /api/content/expand-script accepts anti_repetition_mode parameter. Both strict and balanced modes produce valid output meeting word count floors.

guided_overlay_quick_selector.details: GuidedPracticeContent.jsx displays mode buttons with data-testid='guided-mode-strict-btn' and 'guided-mode-balanced-btn'. Clicking switches mode and shows toast notification.
